items.title: Super Micro Computer Pulls Back 4%, Dell Falls 3% as DDR5 Patent Fight Hits AI Server Makers
items.summary: A fresh DDR5 patent complaint at the International Trade Commission just wiped out a chunk of Super Micro Computer's massive weekly rally, yet the memory maker named in the same filing is trading sharply higher. Here is why the market is splitting the two apart.

items.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Named In Netlist DDR5 ITC Complaint
items.summary: Netlist has filed an ITC complaint naming Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI), Micron, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Lenovo over alleged infringement involving DDR5 memory module technology.

items.title: Dell Stock Is Daring You To Believe Its Numbers
items.summary: Management put a number on the board so big it forces a question, and the market is paying up as if it's a sure thing.

items.title: SanDisk Has Delivered A Return The Index Cannot, And The Swings That Come With It
items.summary: Its correlation to the market is only moderate, so much of what it does is genuinely its own, but the stock has moved several times as far as the index in both directions.

items.title: Cisco Beat On Every Line, Then Fell On What AI Costs To Ship
items.summary: Record revenue, a guide above Wall Street, and a stock down anyway, because the growth now arrives as hardware and the mix shift is what compresses the margin.

items.title: Cisco Just Gave Investors 3 Big Reasons to Be Bullish
items.summary: Cisco just posted its strongest earnings surprise in years, yet the stock dropped sharply the next day. Whether that selloff is a warning sign or a rare entry point comes down to three catalysts that most investors are overlooking.

items.title: Super Micro's Margin Surprise Is Already Guided Back Down
items.summary: The mix that produced it included contracts pushed out of the June quarter, and the September guide already takes the margin back down.
